name: 27041 · Pilot Mtn, NC
findings: ZIP 27041 (Pilot Mtn) has 9 nonprofit organizations. 5 of them (56%) list at least one way to get involved on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 4 organizations.
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 27041 (Pilot Mtn) has fewer organizations offering opportunities per resident.
40% of the organizations offering opportunities have no identified type, so the breakdown by type is partial.
